checks.name: Release preview and consent
checks.evidence: Exact release window exposed both copies and required confirmation before changes.

checks.name: Two installs, old updater, stage and WebView data
checks.evidence: Baseline SHA, release SHA, old updater, staged binary and both synthetic WebView profiles checked on disk.

checks.name: Windows Registry and Desktop shortcut
checks.evidence: Exact positive Run, uninstall and LNK removed. Unrelated entries and shortcut retained.

checks.name: Windows scheduled tasks
checks.evidence: Confirmed task absent True, unrelated task unchanged True, report recorded removal True.

checks.name: Windows service registration
checks.evidence: SCM query Win32 codes confirmed 1060 and unrelated 0. Removal reported True.

checks.name: Unrelated executable, process, documents and junction target
checks.evidence: The same-name worker stayed live. Document and junction-target hashes were preserved.

checks.name: Actual Pulse process
checks.evidence: Disposable baseline process was live before cleanup and its PID appeared in the report.

checks.name: Unrelated actual WebView2 child is preserved
checks.evidence: Independent native child remained True and absent from cleanup plan and removal report True.

checks.name: Actual WebView2 child
checks.evidence: Observed direct children 1, still alive 0, missing removal record 0.

checks.name: Windows sharing and access errors with accurate residuals
checks.evidence: Native Windows codes 32 and 5 were induced, listed for the correct files and matched remaining disk state.

checks.name: Retry after unlocking and restoring the file ACL
checks.evidence: The same release rescanned the disposable installation after its Run hint was restored, then removed the old residuals.

checks.name: Actual runtime profile removal or reported preservation
checks.evidence: Runtime data remains False, observed residues 0, unexplained non-directory entries 0, capped False.

checks.name: Actual dedicated runtime profile fully removed
checks.evidence: Dedicated runtime data remains False, directory entries 0.

checks.name: Repeat after successful cleanup
checks.evidence: No confirmed copies were offered for removal at the third scan.

checks.name: Cleanup executable remains intact
checks.evidence: The exact release cleanup executable remained present and byte-for-byte identical.
